provenance.boundaries: real — public district boundary data, simplified for web rendering
provenance.deficit_indicators: REAL — NFHS-5 2019-21 (IIPS/MoHFW), reconciled onto this boundary set. See docs/DATA-RECONCILIATION.md
provenance.citizen_signals: SYNTHETIC — generated with a deliberate participation bias

water_sanitation.original: आमच्या वाडीतला हातपंप पाच महिन्यांपासून कोरडा आहे.
water_sanitation.english: The handpump in our hamlet has been dry for five months.

water_sanitation.original: बोरवेल बंद पड़ा है, औरतों को दो किलोमीटर चलकर पानी लाना पड़ता है.
water_sanitation.english: The borewell is out of order; women walk two kilometres to fetch water.

water_sanitation.original: নলকূপের জল নোনতা, খেলে পেট খারাপ হয়।
water_sanitation.english: The tubewell water is brackish and makes people ill.

water_sanitation.original: பொது கழிப்பறை பூட்டப்பட்டுள்ளது, ஒரு வருடமாக பழுது பார்க்கவில்லை.
water_sanitation.english: The community toilet block is locked and has not been repaired in a year.

water_sanitation.original: नाली टूटी है, बरसात में घर के सामने पानी भर जाता है.
water_sanitation.english: The drain is broken and water collects in front of our houses in the rains.

roads_transport.original: बरसात में सड़क कीचड़ बन जाती है, एम्बुलेंस गाँव तक नहीं आ पाती.
roads_transport.english: In the rains the road turns to mud and the ambulance cannot reach the village.

roads_transport.original: पुलाचा भाग वाहून गेला आहे, मुलं शाळेत जाऊ शकत नाहीत.
roads_transport.english: Part of the culvert has washed away and children cannot get to school.

roads_transport.original: బస్సు ఇక్కడ ఆగదు, రోడ్డు అంత గోతులమయం.
roads_transport.english: The bus does not stop here any more because the road is full of pits.

roads_transport.original: ರಸ್ತೆ ಹಾಳಾಗಿದೆ, ಮಳೆಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಕಡಿತ.
roads_transport.english: The road has broken up and we are cut off entirely during the monsoon.

electricity.original: ट्रांसफार्मर तीन महीने से जला पड़ा है, शिकायत की पर कोई नहीं आया.
electricity.english: The transformer has been burnt out for three months; we complained and nobody came.

electricity.original: रस्त्यावरचे दिवे बंद आहेत, मुली संध्याकाळी बाहेर पडायला घाबरतात.
electricity.english: The street lights are dead and girls are afraid to go out after dark.

electricity.original: দিনে ছয় ঘণ্টাও বিদ্যুৎ থাকে না, সেচের পাম্প চালানো যায় না।
electricity.english: We do not get six hours of power a day and cannot run the irrigation pump.

electricity.original: થાંભલો નમી ગયો છે, વાયર માણસના માથા સુધી લટકે છે.
electricity.english: The pole is leaning and the wire hangs down to head height.

health.original: उपकेंद्र में नर्स हफ्ते में एक बार आती है, प्रसव के लिए शहर जाना पड़ता है.
health.english: The nurse visits the sub-centre once a week; for deliveries we must travel to town.
The primary health centre building leaks badly.

health.original: रुग्णवाहिका येण्याचा रस्ता नाही, खाटेवरून न्यावं लागतं.
health.english: There is no road for the ambulance; we carry patients on a cot.

education.original: स्कूल की दीवार गिर गई है, बच्चे बरामदे में बैठते हैं.
education.english: The school wall has collapsed and the children sit in the verandah.

education.original: பள்ளியில் பெண் குழந்தைகளுக்கு தனி கழிப்பறை இல்லை.
education.english: The school has no separate toilet for girls.

education.original: একটাই ঘরে তিনটে ক্লাস একসঙ্গে বসে।
education.english: Three classes sit together in a single room.

education.original: पावसाळ्यात वर्गात पाणी गळतं, वह्या भिजतात.
education.english: The classroom leaks in the monsoon and the notebooks get soaked.

sectors.label: Water & Sanitation
sectors.indicator: Households without an improved drinking water source

schemes.name: Jal Jeevan Mission
schemes.eligibility: Rural habitations without functional household tap connections. Priority to water-quality-affected habitations, aspirational districts, and SC/ST majority habitations.

schemes.name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase II
schemes.ministry: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation
schemes.eligibility: Rural households without access to a toilet, and villages requiring solid and liquid waste management assets to sustain ODF status.

sectors.label: Roads & Transport
sectors.indicator: Rural habitations without all-weather road connectivity

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
schemes.eligibility: Eligible unconnected habitations above the population threshold for the relevant terrain category, plus upgradation of existing through routes.

schemes.name: AMRUT 2.0
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.eligibility: Statutory towns, for universal water supply coverage and sewerage or septage management alongside urban mobility assets.

schemes.name: Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme
schemes.eligibility: DISCOM-implemented loss-reduction and metering works, and distribution infrastructure strengthening in areas with poor supply reliability.

schemes.name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana
schemes.eligibility: Rural electrification, feeder separation, and last-mile connectivity for un-electrified and partially electrified households.

sectors.label: Health Facilities
sectors.indicator: Births not delivered in a health facility

schemes.name: National Health Mission
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.eligibility: Facility strengthening against Indian Public Health Standards where sub-centre or PHC shortfall is demonstrated against population norms.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat — Health and Wellness Centre
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.eligibility: Conversion of existing sub-centres and PHCs into Health and Wellness Centres delivering comprehensive primary health care.

sectors.label: Education
sectors.indicator: Children of school age not attending school

schemes.name: Samagra Shiksha
schemes.eligibility: School infrastructure gaps against norms — additional classrooms, drinking water, separate toilets, boundary walls and ramps.

schemes.name: PM SHRI Schools
schemes.eligibility: Selected existing schools upgraded as exemplar schools, with priority to educationally backward blocks.
